verdict.rationale: Evidence that teams can co-work is thin and indirect. A community vulnerability report shows Base44 apps have editor/collaborator roles. The docs also say the GitHub connection supports collaboration, but a shared team workspace is never documented first-party. Missing for 10: first-party docs on team workspaces, inviting members, roles/permissions, real-time co-editing, and independent hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: you could sign yourself up as editor/collaborator on any app once you knew the app's ID
Connect your Base44 app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration.
